sources.snippet: SecPaper-Selector-4B Select the passages that support a security-research question. Given a question and named excerpts, SecPaper-Selector-4B returns the supporting passage IDs or abstains when the supplied material does not establish an answer. It is a Qwen3.5-4B adapter for evidence selection, with an explicit JSON interface.
